sources.snippet: [Business] Item 1. Business Company Background The Company designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. The Company’s fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September. Products iPhone iPhone ® is the Company’s line of smartphones based on its iOS operating system. The iPhone line includes iPhone Duo™, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Air ® , iPhone 17, iPhone 17e and iPhone 16. Mac Mac ® is the Company’s line of personal computers based on its macOS ® operating system. The Mac line includes laptops MacBook Neo ® , MacBook Air ® and MacBook Pro ® , including MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch, as well as desktops iMac ® , Mac mini ® and Mac Studio ® . iPad iPad ® is the Company’s line of multipurpose tablets based on its iPadOS ® operating system. The iPad line includes iPad Pro ® , iPad Air ® , iPad and iPad mini ® . Wearables, Home and Accessories Wearables includes smartwatches, wireless headphones and spatial computers. The Company’s line of smartwatches, based on its watchOS ® operating system, includes Apple Watch ® Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra ® 4 and Apple Watch SE ® 3. The Company’s line of wireless headphones includes AirPods ® , AirPods Pro ® , AirPods Max ® and Beats ® products. Apple Vision Pro ® is the Company’s spatial computer based on its visionOS ® operating system. Home includes Apple TV 4K ® , the Company’s media streaming and gaming device based on its tvOS ® operating system, HomePod ® and HomePod mini ® , high-fidelity wireless smart speakers, and Apple HomeView™, the Company’s smart home display for home control, communication and entertainment. Accessories includes Apple-branded and third-party accessories. This Item generally discusses 2026 and 2025 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2026 and 2025. Discussions of 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024 are not included, and can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 27, 2025. Product, Service and Software Announcements The Company announces new product, service and software offerings at various times during the year. Significant announcements during fiscal year 2026 included the following: First Quarter 2026: • 14-inch MacBook Pro • iPad Pro • Apple Vision Pro Second Quarter 2026: • iPad Air • iPhone 17e • MacBook Neo, MacBook Air and MacBook Pro • AirPods Max 2 Third Quarter 2026: • iOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, visionOS 27 and tvOS 27 • Siri AI Fourth Quarter 2026: • Mac mini and Mac Studio • iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone 18 Pro • Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 • AirPods 5 Macroeconomic Conditions Macroeconomic conditions, including inflation, interest rates, component pricing, supply constraints and currency fluctuations, have directly and indirectly impacted, and could in the future materially impact, the Company’s business, revenue, costs, gross margin, results of operations and financial condition. The Company is experiencing supply constraints and rising costs driven by industry-wide supply-demand imbalances for key components, including advanced semiconductors, memory and storage. The Company expects these trends to intensify for memory and storage components. Actions, such as price increases, that have been and may in the future be taken by the Company may not effectively mitigate these negative impacts, and may also reduce demand for the Company’s products. sources.snippet: EX-99.1 2 a8-kex991q4202609262026.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Apple reports fourth quarter results September quarter records for total company revenue, iPhone revenue, and EPS Services revenue reaches new all-time high CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple ® today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 26, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year. Company gross margin was 47.9 percent, including a favorable impact of approximately 1 percentage point from tariff refunds. Diluted earnings per share was $2.10, up 14 percent year over year, and included a favorable impact of $0.05 from tariff refunds. “Today, Apple is proud to report a September quarter revenue record of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent from a year ago, with iPhone reaching a September quarter record and Services reaching an all-time high, capping off our best fiscal year ever,” said John Ternus, Apple’s CEO. “We’re closing the year with our most ambitious lineup yet. That includes the iPhone Duo, the most transformational iPhone since the original, alongside iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, our most powerful iPhones yet. We also just introduced a whole new generation of hardware for the home and brought Touch to Mac for the first time. Together with the all-new Siri AI, it’s an incredible lineup to carry us into the holiday season.” “Apple delivered September quarter records for net income and EPS. Our record September quarter capped off a strong fiscal 2026, with all-time record revenue of $479 billion and double-digit EPS growth,” said Kevan Parekh, Apple’s CFO. “We generated $28 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, allowing us to return $28 billion to shareholders. Thanks to our very high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty, our installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments.” Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on November 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 12, 2026. Apple will provide live streaming of its Q4 2026 financial results conference call beginning at 2:00 p.m. PT on November 2, 2026, at apple.com/investor/earnings-call. The webcast will be available for replay for approximately two weeks thereafter. Apple periodically provides information for investors on its corporate website, apple.com, and its investor relations website, investor.apple.com. This includes press releases and other information about financial performance, reports filed or furnished with the SEC, information on corporate governance, and details related to its annual meeting of shareholders. This press release contains forward-looking statements, within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995.
